subject: AcreetionOS Update — June 16, 2026
body:
Our continuous integration pipeline has just been fine-tuned again, building on the recent introduction of per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest ISO images, which significantly boosts the reliability and efficiency of our release process. This improvement is a crucial step towards making our release process more robust, and you can read more about the details of this change on our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Development 
The development team is actively working on refining our ISO build pipeline, with recent commits focused on avoiding publish races between concurrent builds and ensuring that the latest ISO images resolve correctly on the host web root. These changes are part of our ongoing effort to make AcreetionOS more reliable and efficient, and you can learn more about our development process on our wiki page at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.

Community 
The AcreetionOS community has been actively discussing the latest security updates, including the recent release of Emacs 31.1 and Sunday's stable kernel set. We encourage all users to stay up-to-date with the latest security patches, and you can find more information on our documentation page at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html. Additionally, our community is always looking for ways to improve and expand our documentation, so if you're interested in contributing, please visit our website at https://acreetionos.org/ for more information. Tip of the day: if you're looking for the latest ISO image, you can find it on our flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html.
